skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Given two fractions with different denominators, determine the least common denominator and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Perform integer subtraction of whole number parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part subtraction yields a negative result, decrement the whole number by 1 and add the denominator to the numerator of the minuend's fraction.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert improper fraction to mixed number
skills.definition: For a mixed number with an improper fraction part, convert the improper fraction to a mixed number and add to the whole part to obtain a proper mixed number.

skills.name: Rewrite whole number as mixed number
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5).

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator (LCD) and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerator of the second fraction from the first, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole part of the subtrahend from the whole part of the minuend, including zero if applicable.

skills.name: Convert to equivalent mixed number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with zero fraction, or borrow from the whole part to increase the fraction (e.g., when fraction subtraction yields a negative result).

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Handle mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into its whole part and fraction part, and combine a whole part and a fraction part into a mixed number. Also includes rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with zero fraction.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: When the fraction part of a mixed number is negative after subtraction, convert one whole from the whole part into a fraction with the same denominator and add it to the fraction part, then subtract again.

skills.name: Convert improper fraction to mixed number
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction (where numerator is greater than or equal to denominator) into a mixed number by dividing numerator by denominator to get the whole part and remainder.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fraction part subtraction yields a negative result, reduce the whole part by 1 and add the denominator to the fraction part, then re-evaluate the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Rewrite whole number as mixed number
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator by writing it as whole + 0/d.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators and keep the denominator when denominators are equal.

skills.name: Whole number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract one whole number from another.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the subtrahend is larger than that of the minuend, decrease the whole number by 1 and add the denominator to the fraction numerator.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Whole number to mixed representation
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator (e.g., 3 = 3 + 0/5).
